# Support

## Research-only use

This platform is for **computational biomedical research** on public knowledge and curated disease modules. It is not medical advice and must not be used with protected health information (PHI).

## Getting help

| Need | Channel |
|------|---------|
| Bug reports | [Open an issue](https://github.com/AdamEddahmouni/med-research/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml) |
| Feature ideas | [Feature request template](https://github.com/AdamEddahmouni/med-research/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml) |
| Security issues | [Private security advisory](https://github.com/AdamEddahmouni/med-research/security/advisories/new) — do not file public issues |
| Documentation | [README](../README.md), [docs/](../docs/), [CONTRIBUTING](../CONTRIBUTING.md) |

## Maintainer launch checklist

See [docs/public-launch.md](../docs/public-launch.md) before changing repository visibility to public.
